fact: Zambia's Ministry of Education proposes to equip 250 primary schools with tablets, solar kits and Wi-Fi so that school-based information systems capture and transmit EMIS data in real time (grant period 1 November 2025 to 31 October 2028).
title: System Transformation Grant and System Capacity Grant: Full Application Proposal to GPE
publisher: Ministry of Education, Zambia (to the Global Partnership for Education)
